name: com.appusula/appusula
title: appusula: App Store ASO
description: Your App Store keyword ranks, rank history, reviews and alerts, plus listing checks. Works on Free.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List the apps (owned + competitors) tracked in your appusula workspace, with rating, version, and store ids.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Get details for one app by its appusula id (from list_apps).

tools.name: get_app_keywords
tools.description: List an app's tracked keywords with their appusula keyword id (for get_keyword_history), latest rank in the keyword's storefront (null = not in the top 200 or not checked yet) and when it was checked, difficulty, search popularity (1-5, needs Apple Ads), and ranks found in other storefronts.

tools.name: get_app_reviews
tools.description: Get an app's reviews, newest first, with optional filters (rating range, version, country, last N days, unanswered only) and a summary of everything that matches: counts by rating, by version (with average and 1-2 star counts), by topic (word matching, no AI), and appusula's stored AI themes. Each review says whether it has a developer reply. draft_replies adds reply drafts for unanswered reviews: saved drafts for free, plus up to 5 new ones from appusula's AI on Indie and Studio (each one AI run). Drafts are returned only: nothing is saved, sent or posted.

limit.description: max reviews listed, 1-100 (default 25); the summary covers every match

maxRating.description: highest star rating, 1-5 (e.g. 2 for 1-2 star reviews)

version.description: only reviews of this app version, e.g. 2.0.4

country.description: only this storefront, 2 letters, e.g. us

days.description: only reviews from the last N days, 1-365

unansweredOnly.description: only reviews without a developer reply

draft_replies.description: add reply drafts for the listed unanswered reviews (never posted)

tools.name: get_keyword_history
tools.description: Get a tracked keyword's rank history over time (rank + capturedAt), newest first, by its appusula keyword id.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List your workspace's recent alerts (rank moves, review spikes, new competitors…), newest first.

tools.name: track_keyword
tools.description: Start tracking a keyword on one of your apps in a storefront. Changes the workspace: run it only after the user approves this exact keyword and storefront. Respects your plan's keyword caps. Requires the write:keywords scope (Indie, Studio).

tools.name: untrack_keyword
tools.description: Stop tracking a keyword. Deletes it and its rank history for good: run it only after the user approves removing this exact keyword. Requires the write:keywords scope (Indie, Studio).

tools.name: validate_metadata
tools.description: Check App Store or Google Play listing text against the store limits before you submit: characters per field, Apple's 100-byte keyword field in UTF-8 bytes, and keyword-field waste (spaces, duplicates, plurals, words already in the name or subtitle) with a cleaned version. Works on any text, no tracked app needed.
